result.note: A short item on a private-sector AI launch; one question tests what Gnani Artha is and what it combines.

questions.prompt: In August 2026, Vice-President C. P. Radhakrishnan launched 'Gnani Artha'. Which of the following best describes it?
options: A sovereign AI stack combining a language model with a workflow platform
A satellite constellation built for secure government communications
A semiconductor fabrication unit for making indigenous AI chips
A digital public platform for settling cross-border rupee payments
questions.explain: Gnani Artha is a homegrown sovereign AI stack. It pairs the large language model Evon 3.3 with Plexus, a platform that connects AI tools to institutional workflows. It was developed by Bengaluru-based GNANI AI.
questions.source: The stack combines Evon 3.3, a large language model, with Plexus, a platform connecting AI tools to institutional workflows.
